notes: Hand-curated synthetic fixture for the senior data engineer archetype. One ExpectedUnit per fact-bearing bullet in EXPERIENCE + SIDE PROJECTS sections. Role-intro paragraphs and the WRITING section are intentionally not labeled.

expected_units.normalized_summary: Led migration from shared-schema Snowflake to per-tenant database model with metadata-driven dbt project, cutting p95 latency for top 20 tenants by 47% and unblocking SOC 2 Type II
Built incremental-models framework on dbt standardizing late-arriving data, snapshot strategy, and freshness SLAs across 1,400+ models; mean build time from 38m to 11m
Owned Airflow-to-Dagster migration mapping 220+ DAGs into asset-based pipelines with six-month dual-run; reduced top-10 backfill times 4-12x

Designed data-contract layer with Postgres CDC to Parquet on S3 validated against versioned Avro schema registry, quarantining rejected events with Slack alerts; reduced incorrect-dashboard incidents ~70% YoY
Built Snowflake cost-attribution pipeline tagging queries to dbt model, dashboard, and tenant; surfaced $340k annualized waste in first quarter and enabled per-tenant chargeback
Hired and onboarded three data engineers; authored interview rubric, on-call runbook, and performance-calibration doc
Rebuilt watch-event pipeline from Kinesis-to-Redshift batch into Spark Structured Streaming on Delta Lake; latency from ~45m to under 90s, unblocking same-day programming decisions

Owned canonical content-metadata model (title, season, episode, edit, asset, region, license window) replacing four drifted tables with a single SCD2 source of truth; migrated 80+ downstream models in a quarter
Designed recommendation-features warehouse with hourly per-user denormalized tables and 24-hour replay; powered offline training and online personalization feature lookups
Bootstrapped analytics-engineering practice with dbt — project structure, CI gate, first 80 models; now used by 4 teams across ~600 models
Led Looker-to-Mode BI migration; re-implemented top-30 dashboards, deprecated 200+ unused looks, ran enablement sessions for ~50 users
Owned data-platform on-call rotation for two years; authored incident-response runbook and reduced repeat incidents 60% via a post-incident-review action-item tracker

Built bid-request log pipeline ingesting ~3.5 billion events/day from RTB exchanges with Kafka, Spark batch, S3 Parquet, Hive metastore; system of record for revenue reconciliation, ran 6 years post-departure
Designed impression-deduplication across nine ad-server endpoints, cutting double-counting from ~2.1% to <0.05% and recovering $1.2M in over-billed refunds annually
Migrated warehouse from on-prem Vertica to Snowflake; hand-ported 600+ stored procedures with a single-weekend cutover and one fast-recovered rollback
Built data-quality framework wrapping every nightly job with row-count, null-rate, and schema-drift assertions; surfaced a six-figure billing bug in week one
Mentored two junior engineers, one of whom is now a staff engineer at the same company
Built Sleet — open-source cost-aware Snowflake query advisor that profiles spend, attributes it to dbt models and dashboards, and suggests rewrites
Built dbt-quarantine — a dbt package codifying the quarantine-and-replay pattern for late-arriving and rejected rows; used at three other companies
